title: Promo video script
description: One video: a language, a color theme, a music style and an ordered list of scenes. Scene length follows the voice-over; you never set timings by hand. Full reference: docs/script-format.md

lang.description: Language code; must have a block in ads.json › lang. Screens are looked up as screens/<lang>-<clip>.* first, then screens/<clip>.*

theme.description: Key of ads.json › themes (background gradient, glow and highlight colors). Default: the first theme.

colors.description: Per-video color overrides on top of the theme.

tail.description: Seconds of breathing room after each spoken line (default: ads.json › tail, else 0.2).

badges.description: Store pills on the end card (default: ads.json › badges).

captions.description: false = no burned-in captions (the .vtt is still written).

brand.description: false = hide the small app icon + name in the corner.

sfx.description: false = no whoosh / pop / ding sound effects.

angle.description: Free text: the idea of this video. Ignored by the engine; useful for humans and agents.

glow.description: Soft moving blob in the background.

say.description: Voice-over line, about 8-15 words. Scene length = spoken length + tail.

cap.description: Caption text when it should differ from `say` (same number of words reads best).

big.description: Headline. *stars* highlight words, \n breaks lines. Max 2 lines of ~18 characters.

hold.description: Extra seconds after the line (e.g. 1.0 on the end card).

duration.description: Fixed length, only for scenes without `say`.

still.description: Second within the scene used by `stills` (default 80% of the scene).

confetti.description: Burst confetti (with a ding) at this second of the scene.

mood.description: Optional emotion tag for this line, e.g. "excited". Use sparingly: per-line tags often make the voice jumpy.

icon.description: Optional emoji or symbol; a colored dot when omitted.

pos.description: [x, y] pixels; overrides the default slot for every aspect.

shakeAt.description: Second when the chat card shakes (the 'chaos' beat).

badge.description: Group avatar text or emoji (default: first letter of the title).

me.description: Right-aligned bubble in the theme color.

emoji.description: A big emoji instead of a text bubble.

oneOf.title: phone: screenshot or recording in a phone (or a card)

clip.description: Media name in screens/ without extension or language prefix.

clips.description: Several media in one scene, split evenly, each with an optional label.

from.description: Recordings only: start second (when the screen has finished loading).

device.description: card = a 4:5 rounded card without a bezel, for product photos.

zoom.description: Magnify the screen around a point: s = scale (1.2-1.5), x/y = 0..1 focus point, at = start second (default 0.8).

tilt.description: Resting rotation of the device in degrees.

items.description: Tiles for this scene (default: ads.json › lang.<lang>.features).

icon.description: Path relative to the project (white glyph SVG/PNG looks best).

url.description: Default: ads.json › url. Empty string hides it.
